Grounding obligation description: Channels (channels.channel_id/channel_name) that contain at least one message (messages.message_id) authored by a user (messages.user_id -> users.user_id) whose name is Robert and who holds a workspace membership (user_teams) in the team (teams.team_id) T01WORKSPACE. The shared first name 'Robert' is genuinely ambiguous between two distinct workspace members (an admin and a plain member), each with their own actually-authored-message channel set; no delegated tie-breaker is given.
Shared scope: channels in team T01WORKSPACE containing a message authored by a user named Robert who has a user_teams row for that team
